name: @stuffed/server
description: Authoritative game server: a Cloudflare Worker with one Durable Object per room.

scripts.dev: wrangler d1 migrations apply stuffed --local && wrangler dev --port 1999
scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply stuffed --remote && wrangler deploy --assets ../../packages/client/dist --var ALLOWED_ORIGINS:https://pluffs.cz,https://www.pluffs.cz,https://stuffed-rooms.partyhub-vs.workers.dev
scripts.dev:lan: wrangler d1 migrations apply stuffed --local && wrangler dev --port 1999 --ip 0.0.0.0
